verdict.rationale: The axis applies because stagewise runs a cloud account and enterprise service (SSO/SCIM, optional self-hosted cloud), so it could plausibly issue scoped agent credentials. The evidence only shows BYOK, where users supply their own provider API keys for the agents to consume. There is no evidence of stagewise issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents, and the OpenAPI probe found no public API at any checked path.
